notes: v1.10.6 - Keyboard: Ctrl+End jumps from scrollback back to live output (Esc on an empty command line does too), Ctrl+Home to the top. Copy Lua: each trigger, alias and timer list gets a Copy Lua button that puts the selected rule on the clipboard as plugin code (scrye.addTrigger / addAlias / every), with what a plugin rule cannot do noted as comments. A notice at startup names the plugins you use that have a newer version in the catalogue. Plugin API 1.23: input widgets take a width in characters. Plugins: 3S Map GMCP 1.13.0 adds hand links for doors the map cannot see ('mapg link', or the Link last move button), and 1.12.1 stops false EXITS CHANGED warnings; Farmer 1.6.1 no longer swings at dead mobs and guards after a kill; Viking Status 2.27.5 adds a Staffing view in the People tab, the livestock market's new home and an incoming-war warning, with coloured ON/OFF and compact settings on Trade Auto (2.27.4); Viking Kingdom 1.1.0 shows incoming war and the war saga.
